title.value: Run Terraform plan and apply through an MCP agent

introduction.value: The author had Cursor run Terraform against Postgres via MCP; the apply hit a permissions error and he finished from the terminal.

method.value: Weston Platter installed the tfmcp server and added it to Cursor's mcp.json, pointing it at a local Terraform directory. He wrote a main.tf for a Postgres role, database and schema, then had the agent run plan and apply. When the apply failed, he ran it in the terminal and granted CREATEROLE and CREATEDB through psql.

outcome.value: The MCP never showed the actual Terraform errors. Cursor's own Run tool displayed them and suggested setting superuser = false, after which apply worked. He concluded tfmcp made the workflow no easier than the command line.

notes.value: The MCP hid the Terraform error output, so be ready to run commands directly. Also, an MCP is third-party code running on your machine.

source_text.body:
Run Terraform plan and apply through an MCP agent
The author had Cursor run Terraform against Postgres via MCP; the apply hit a permissions error and he finished from the terminal.
Done with
CR
Cursor
What they did
Weston Platter installed the tfmcp server and added it to Cursor's mcp.json, pointing it at a local Terraform directory. He wrote a main.tf for a Postgres role, database and schema, then had the agent run plan and apply. When the apply failed, he ran it in the terminal and granted CREATEROLE and CREATEDB through psql.
How it went
The MCP never showed the actual Terraform errors. Cursor's own Run tool displayed them and suggested setting superuser = false, after which apply worked. He concluded tfmcp made the workflow no easier than the command line.
Worth knowing
The MCP hid the Terraform error output, so be ready to run commands directly. Also, an MCP is third-party code running on your machine.
Try it yourself
with
Cursor
Copy prompt
Connect to my Terraform project and database via MCP, run a terraform plan against [resource/environment], and summarize what will change. Pause and show me the exact plan before running apply, since this will modify infrastructure.
Original source: https://masterpoint.io/blog/using-mcps-to-run-terraform/
